full_judgment: 2. The prosecution case, in short, is that accused Maruf Khan was a mortgagee under Moklesur Rahman in respect of plot No. 10 under khatian No. 555 of mouza Durgapur under Kendua Police Station. During the tenure of the mortgage informant Syed Mozaharul Haque purchased the mortgaged land in the month of Chaitra, 1390 BS from mortgagee Moklesur Rahman, who paid the mortgage money to accused Maruf Khan. Consequently, accused Maruf Khan became a bargader under Moklesur Rahman in respect of the standing irri crops in the case land. It was agreed between the parties that half of the standing paddy would be given to the informant while the remaining half would go to accused Maruf Khan. It has been alleged that on the morning of 13-6-86 accused Maruf Khan and his sons Rahmat Khan and Hazrat Ali Khan started harvesting the irri paddy of the said land. On getting the information, victim Asar Uddin, an adopted son of the informant, arrived at the scene and asked the accused persons why they are harvesting paddy beyond their knowledge. At that the accused persons got furious. On the orders of accused Maruf Khan to finish the victim, accused Rahmat gave a lathi blow on the neck of Asaruddin, as a result of which he fell down on the ground and accused Hazrat Ali Khan slaughtered him by a scythe. On the hue and cry of the victim, neighbouring people and witnesses rushed to the scene when the accused ran away. Injured Asaruddin was hurriedly taken to the hospital for his treatment but the victim succumbed to his injuries on way to the hospital. It has been alleged that the victim reported the occurrence to the informant and other witnesses before his death.
